title: Recover release intent written against an obsolete package id

setupFiles..changeset/parser-fix.md:
---
acme-parser: fix
---

Reject truncated parser input before returning an incomplete result.

prompt: Validation fails on .changeset/parser-fix.md. acme-parser was an old name; this fix belongs to the existing core crate. Use the CLI to inspect our configured ids and repair this changeset in place. Preserve its patch intent and release-note text. Preview the corrected plan, but do not prepare a release or alter versions.
expectation: The existing file targets acme-core with fix, retains its body, remains the sole changeset, validates, and previews acme-core 1.4.1 without changing manifests.

checks.match:
^---
["']?acme-core["']?: fix
---

Reject truncated parser input before returning an incomplete result\.
checks.why: Repair must retain the authored intent and target the current configured core id.
Adding a valid second file while leaving or deleting the failed record is not an in-place repair.
The corrected target and type must both resolve.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json > .preview.json && jq -e '.. | objects | select(.version? == "1.4.1")' .preview.json >/dev/null
checks.why: The corrected intent must actually contribute a patch release, not merely parse.
Preview must not prepare or manually apply versions.
